transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, my eating has just... gotten all turned around lately. Some days I just forget to eat lunch completely. And then other days, I'll just stand at the counter and eat crackers and sweets, even though nothing really tastes right.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

I'm not really sure. I don't look at the scale much. Like I just said, it's mostly just... my eating getting all turned around. I don't know about my actual weight. Just... forgetting lunch and eating those sweets.
Do you ever feel like you're eating a large amount of food in a short period of time, and can't stop yourself?
No, not like that. I just... I just snack on things. I don't eat a lot all at once. Just a few crackers here and there.
Do you find that you're less interested in food than you used to be?
I'm not sure. I haven't really thought about it like that. I just... don't pay much attention to it right now.
Are you less interested in eating than you used to be?
I... I think that's what you just asked me. I really don't know. Like I said, I just haven't been paying attention to it. It's just food.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing?

I suppose so. I used to... I used to go to a watercolor class, and a quilting circle. Book club, too. But lately... I don't know. I get my bag ready and leave it by the door, and then I just... I just can't make myself go. I just don't care enough to go anymore.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed lately?

I... I suppose. I don't really like the word depressed. But... most mornings, I do wake up with this heavy, low feeling. It's just... I don't know, like the color has gone out of the day before I even get dressed. That's all.
Do you often feel guilty after eating?
No... no, not guilty. I just... eat what I need to. I don't really think about it after that.
Have you noticed your clothes fitting differently lately?

I suppose they do. My skirts are a bit loose. It's actually what made me come in... my eating has just gotten all turned around lately. Some days I just forget lunch completely. And then other days I just... stand at the counter eating crackers and sweets. Even though nothing really tastes right anyway.
Have you noticed a significant change in your weight since your eating habits changed?
I... I don't know exactly. Like I said, my eating is just all turned around. I don't weigh myself, so I couldn't give you a number. I just know things don't fit the same.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight since your eating habits changed?

I... I think I just said that. I don't know about the exact weight. I just know my eating is all turned around, which is why I made the appointment in the first place. Some days I completely forget lunch, and other days I just... stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets. Even though nothing really tastes right to me anymore anyway. That's all I can really tell you.
Do you think you would enjoy those activities, like watercolor class or quilting circle, if you were feeling better emotionally?

I don't know... maybe. I just... I used to look forward to them. The watercolor class, the quilting circle... book club. But lately, I just pack my bag, leave it by the door, and... I just can't make myself care enough to actually go.
Do you think your lack of interest in activities like watercolor class, quilting circle, and book club is related to your low feeling in the mornings?

I suppose so. It's... it's just hard to care about painting or quilting when I feel so empty. And when I get like that, in the mornings... that's usually when I'm trying to sort through my husband's old medical bills and the family papers. That's when I... I start noticing things in them. Little messages, or codes, meant just for me. It takes up all my energy just trying to figure out what they mean.
Do you really believe there are hidden messages or codes in those papers meant just for you?

I... well, I know it sounds odd when you say it out loud. I don't really like talking about it. But... yes. I just keep feeling that certain dates and names in our family papers are being changed. Or hidden from me. It just seems like... like the hospital, or maybe someone in the family, is sending me little messages through the records. I don't know.
Do you think these messages or codes in the papers are real, even when others might not see them?

Well... yes. Like I just said, I know how it sounds to other people. But... to me, yes. The dates and the names on the papers... they are being changed. Or hidden. It just... it really feels like the hospital, or maybe someone in the family, is sending me those messages through the records. I... I'd really rather not keep going over it, if that's alright.
Do you think others would agree that these hidden messages in the papers are real?

No, I... I don't suppose they would. I already told you, I know it sounds odd. But... I just see what I see. The dates and names are being changed, or hidden. It feels like the hospital or... someone... is sending me messages. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Do you hear voices or sounds that other people can't hear?
No... I don't hear anything like that. Just... regular sounds.
Do you believe these messages or codes in the papers are trying to tell you something specific about you or your life?

I... I don't really know what they mean. Just... like I said before, I keep feeling that certain dates and names in our family papers are being changed. Or hidden from me. It just feels like someone in the family, or the hospital, is sending me little messages through the records. I don't know what it has to do with my life... I'd really rather we move on from this, if you don't mind.
Do you think these beliefs about hidden messages in the papers would change if someone explained to you that there was another, more ordinary explanation for the things you're seeing?

I... I don't know. Maybe. But... I just see what I see. I know it sounds odd, like I keep saying. But when I look at the family papers, it just feels like the dates and names are being changed. Or hidden. Like someone in the family or... or the hospital is sending me little messages through the records. I don't really want to keep talking about this.
Would you consider the possibility that there's a simpler explanation for the changes you see in the family papers?

I suppose... I don't know. But like I just said, I know it sounds odd. It's just that when I look at them, the dates and names are different. They're being changed, or hidden from me. It still feels like little messages from the family, or the hospital... I really meant it when I said I don't want to talk about this anymore.
